appraisal_events.evidence: "Je recommençai à être dur avec elle comme à Balbec... j'employais à blâmer mon amie les mêmes raisons qui m'avaient été si souvent opposées par mes parents, quand j'étais petit, et qui avaient paru inintelligentes et cruelles à mon enfance incomprise"; "je ne peux pas vous plaindre... je n'apprécie pas la sensibilité des gens qui prétendent tant nous aimer sans être capables de nous rendre le plus léger service."
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator harshly reproaches Albertine for her visible sadness and accuses her of feigned sensitivity, deliberately reusing the very reproaches he once judged unintelligent and cruel when directed at him as a child, which frames the blame as an inherited, somewhat hollow performance rather than a fully endorsed judgment.

status_effects.explanation: Albertine is locally diminished by being accused of feigned or wasted sensibility and denied sympathy despite her visible sadness.
Her disappointment ("Son visage reflétait une déception") is met with rebuke rather than comfort, leaving her emotionally rebuffed within the scene.

ambiguities: The narrator's harsh blame of Albertine explicitly echoes rhetoric he once judged unintelligent and cruel when it was directed at him as a child, which complicates whether the passage endorses this blame or exposes it as an inherited, hollow performance.
